Our Story

7 YEARS
OF CRISP.

CRISP began with a simple conviction: a haircut is architecture. For seven years our multidisciplinary, multicultural team of stylists and barbers has set a new standard for modern artisanal grooming in Montréal — precision craftsmanship, honest consultation, and cuts built around the person in the chair, never the trend of the week.

Every appointment starts with listening. Then comes the craft — measured, deliberate, finished by hand.
